objs.name: document
objs.description: Document is the primary object type representing policies, guidelines, work instructions and related materials.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment is an object type representing attached files or information objects linked to a Document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional Info is a document type used for supplementary information related to a Document.

objs.name: equippments
objs.description: Equippments is a document type for equipment-related information attached to a Document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: User represents individuals who interact with documents, roles and authorizations.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: User Group represents a collection of users with a common permission set.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational Unit represents an organizational subdivision to which Documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_applications
objs.description: IT Applications represents master data that can be linked to Documents.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master Data represents generic master data that can be linked to Documents.

evts.name: attach_information_object
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object to a Document.

evts.name: link_documents
evts.description: Link Documents refers to linking a Document with other Documents or Master Data / IT Applications / Organizational Units.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser releases a Document to readers.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a Document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate Document involved in the translation workflow.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Sign Document using electronic signatures.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create Change Proposal for a Document.

evts.name: manage_change_proposal
evts.description: Manage Change Proposal for a Document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extend Validity for a Document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Override Document for invalidation or override scenarios.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Invalidate Document as part of AKS process.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate Document after invalidation.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribute Document to Distribution List / User Groups.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Distribute By Email of a Document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive Document and related Attachments.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Publish Document after release.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Create New Version of a Document.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Assign Authorizations to Documents for Groups and Users.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release Translation after translation workflow.

evts.description: Attach Information Object to a Document.
